usage_audit.interpretation: Counts unique JSONL files physically present under the evaluation output. Tool events count classified tool-call item types; other non-message items and top-level CLI errors are reported separately. Replay methods are not double-counted unless they created a duplicate trace file.

interpretation_limits: TLC completed trips and synthetic fleets are proxy inputs, not real requests and vehicle trajectories.

Thirty selected calendar dates are date clusters, but dates were quantile-stratified rather than sampled from all NYC dates; intervals describe selected-window variation and do not establish citywide effects.
Replicate seeds estimate simulation/model-run variation only on these selected inputs; dates remain the demand clusters.
Token usage is not actual Codex account billing; replayed responses must not be counted twice.
